items.headline: Anthropic files paperwork to become a publicly traded company
items.summary: Anthropic, the company behind Claude, filed an S-1 with the SEC, the form a company submits when it plans to sell shares to the public for the first time (an IPO).
items.why_it_matters: It signals Claude is here to stay as a business tool, but it changes nothing about your plan or pricing today. Treat it as background, not a to-do.
